identity.notes: Private equity country club community in Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410, featuring ~447 Mediterranean Revival-style homes around an Arnold Palmer Signature 18-hole golf course. Governed by the Frenchman's Reserve Master Property Owners Association, Inc. (est. 02/13/2001, Federal ID 020589883), separate from the country club entity. Club membership is equity-required and separate from POA fees.

fees.note: Monthly equivalent range ~$959-$1,510 depending on home type. Quarterly dues: ~$3,369 single-family, ~$4,530 coach homes, ~$2,877 certain custom homes. One-time capital contribution equal to one quarter of dues collected at closing. Dues cover security, landscaping (most homes), cable/internet, and alarm monitoring. Exact current fees, transfer fees, and special assessments unavailable without direct contact to POA. Club membership is equity-required and separate from POA fees.
Approximate annual equivalent for single-family homes (4 x $3,369/quarter). Coach homes ~$18,120/yr; custom homes ~$11,508/yr.

Mandatory club equity membership initiation fee - Full Golf category (effective Feb 1, 2026), non-refundable; every owner must hold an equity membership (Full Golf or Social/Sport), separate from POA/HOA fees. Full Golf equity capped at 349 memberships by by-laws; includes unlimited golf, 7-day tee-time sign-up, tennis, pickleball, pool, fitness, spa, social use, all greens/court fees included. Family privileges for spouse/domestic partner and unmarried children under 30 living at home or in full-time school. Tenant use only with 90+ day lease, club approval 30+ days ahead, 2 tenants/year cap, 2-year lifetime limit per tenant; owner privileges reduced to dining only during lease term. Source is a real-estate agent blog, not the club's official site - verify with club membership office. (Also observed: TTM ~16 closings, avg sale ~$3.01M / ~$612 psf, ~78 DOM; median list ~$3.35M as of Mar 2026 vs trailing median sale ~$2.775M, +~7% YoY.) Community is a Toll Brothers build of ~448 Mediterranean homes (2002-2013): 341 single-family, 56 coach, 50 custom; clubhouse runs 45,000 sq ft per this source (club site confirms Grande Clubhouse but not size). Social/Sport equity: unlimited tennis/pickleball/pool/fitness/spa/social plus limited golf; only available on homes already carrying a Social/Sport equity; upgrades to Full Golf subject to the 349-cap and must be confirmed in writing. Equity contribution refundability: page cut off before answering - unverified. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.55.)
Mandatory club equity membership initiation fee - Social/Sport category (effective Feb 1, 2026), non-refundable. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.55.)

Annual capital charge per membership tied to the club improvement program, scheduled through 2026; applies to both Full Golf and Social/Sport equity. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.55.)

Annual club dues on a November-to-October cycle, plus an annual food-and-beverage minimum counting a la carte spend across the Grille, Main Dining, Parc, the Turn Station, and the Pool Window. Specific dollar amounts not stated in source. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.55.)

HOA dues (Frenchman's Reserve Master Property Owners Association) sit on top of, and separate from, all club charges; specific amount not stated in source. (Retrieved 2026-09-15T12:00:00Z, confidence 0.55.)
